title: Global Scenarios 1995-2020 (public booklet)
notes: Public booklet; the booklet's page footers carry 1999 print dates. Shell lists the set as 1996.

entries.label: Just Do It!
entries.quote: In the first scenario, success comes to those who harness the latest innovations in technology to identify and take advantage of quick-moving opportunities in a world of hypercompetition, customisation, self-reliance, and ad-hoc informal networking.
entries.subject: global business environment

entries.label: Da Wo ('Big Me')
entries.quote: Da Wo (‘Big Me’) – In the second scenario, countries and companies discover that success calls for a committed investment in relationships, where relationships of trust and the enabling role of government provide the long-term strategic advantage.
entries.subject: global business environment
energy demand
entries.quote: In the dematerialising world of Just Do It!, world energy demand increases at about the same rate as the world population growth of 1.3% per year.
entries.note: Average annual rate over the scenario period (1995-2020).

entries.subject: energy intensity
entries.quote: World energy intensity decreases by an average of 2.1% per year, in part because of more fuel-efficient cars.
entries.note: Sentence interleaved with a sidebar in the PDF text layer; reassembled. Average over 1995-2020.
